description: Standalone USB Wi-Fi auditor for Windows, Linux and macOS (Wifite, but USB-only and cross-platform).
notes: Windows x64 only upstream: there is no arm64 build.
wifit3 ships its own Python ports of the Linux wireless drivers and talks to the adapter over USB, bypassing the Windows NDIS/Wi-Fi stack.
On first use it asks for UAC once to bind the adapter to WinUSB. Use 'Remove Driver' in the app (also UAC) to undo it.
Works with specific USB adapters only; see the upstream README for the supported chipset list.
